SELECT r.id AS requestId, m.name AS drugName, m.total_volume AS totalVolume, r.dose, r.dose_unit_code AS doseUnitCode, r.quantity, r.unit_code AS unitCode, r.method_code AS methodCode, r.rate_code AS frequencyCode, r.lot_number AS lotNumber, r.status_enum AS statusEnum FROM med_medication_request r JOIN med_medication_definition m ON m.id = r.medication_id WHERE r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.intent_enum = 'OUTPATIENT' AND r.status_enum = 'PENDING' AND r.patient_id = #{query.patientId} AND r.encounter_id = #{query.encounterId}
AND r.location_id = #{query.locationId}
